manna_treads._note: Optional - PASS C, stage two. Every value here is also the default in code, so the block may be left out. A key set to null is left off the SAP order. item_allowlist: the only items PASS C may put on a Manna Treads order (an empty list allows none). approvers: the only ERPNext users whose request (custom_mt_so_requested_by) PASS C acts on - a System Manager who approves on the dashboard must be added (an empty list accepts nobody). GST is not configurable: 18%, rate GST-inclusive. username/password may be added to log in to MANNA_TREADS_LIVE as someone else; otherwise the sap login is used.

order_flow._note: Optional. Absent, or mode hitech_direct, is the flow above (PASS A to Hi-Tech on approval, PASS C bills Manna Treads). manna_first (3 Nov 2026): PASS M makes every new order of 'units' created on or after 'since' a Manna Treads Sales Order to the end customer as soon as it is in ERPNext, on the shared finished-goods codes, at the order's rate net of GST, with the tax code from the customer's bill-to state; PASS A leaves those orders alone. Older orders keep the old route. since is required for manna_first. item_allowlist is optional (absent = any item that is the same code and name in Manna Treads SAP). company_db and the login are manna_treads' above. sap.pinned_cert_sha256 (optional, Windows PowerShell 5.1) accepts the Service Layer only with that certificate.
order_flow._note_b1if: B1if (sap-b1if/, 4 Nov 2026) makes Manna Treads' purchase order to Hi-Tech and Hi-Tech's sales order from it, for the sales orders PASS M made; this script never does. PASS P and PASS H only find them by NumAtCard = the ERPNext name and write them back (custom_mt_purchase_order / _entry, custom_sap_sales_order - so PASS B follows it), and refuse an order still without one after b1if_wait_minutes. intercompany may be left out; "script" is refused. Needs custom_mt_purchase_order and custom_mt_purchase_order_entry on Sales Order - see erpnext-setup.md.
